items.title: In Other News: Tor Exit Relays Hijacked, Banks Spot Rogue AI Agents, Self-Rebuilding macOS Ransomware
items.summary: Noteworthy stories that might have slipped under the radar: Russia’s APT28 hit NATO defense firms, PingCAP source code stolen, ShinyHunters negotiator probe. The post In Other News: Tor Exit Relays Hijacked, Banks Spot Rogue AI Agents, Self-Rebuilding macOS Ransomware appeared first on SecurityWeek .
items.title_zh: 其他新聞：Tor 出口中繼站遭劫持、銀行發現惡意 AI 代理、具備自我重建能力的 macOS 勒索軟體
items.summary_zh: 值得關注但可能被忽略的新聞：俄羅斯的 APT28 攻擊了北約國防企業、PingCAP 原始碼遭竊、對 ShinyHunters 談判人員的調查。「In Other News: Tor Exit Relays Hijacked, Banks Spot Rogue AI Agents, Self-Rebuilding macOS Ransomware」這篇文章首次出現在 SecurityWeek。

items.title: Attackers Exploit Third Arista VCO Zero-Day in Four Months
items.summary: The critical-severity SQL injection flaw allows attackers to access privileged internal functionality and gain operator privileges. The post Attackers Exploit Third Arista VCO Zero-Day in Four Months appeared first on SecurityWeek .
